thresholds.title: A-share multi-candle price-volume event incremental-information test
thresholds.regime_rule: BULL: Index>MA20>MA60 ; BEAR: Index<MA20<MA60 ; else NEUTRAL

anchors.rule: anchor = T for every event; the E0x_CONF / E05_RETRACE / E06_REC* labels are separate samples anchored at their confirmation day C
anchors.E06: T (E06_CONF / REC50 / REC75 / RECHI anchor at C)

event_rules.E05: close>rolling_high_20(T-1 version) & volume_ratio_20>=VR15 & retrace within T+1..T+5 (vr<VRCAP & low>=breakout*(1-PULL))
event_rules.E06: close<open & volume_ratio_20>=VR25 & recovery above (high[T]+low[T])/2 within T+1..T+5
event_rules.E07: lower_shadow/range>=SR & lower_shadow>=body*SHADOW_MULT & vol[T+1]<vol[T] & bullish bar with vr>=VR12 within T+1..T+3
event_rules.E08: gap_open>=GAP2 & low[T]>high[T-1] & gap held (low>=high[T-1]) and volume shrinking over T+1..T+5
event_rules.E09: ret_1d[T]>=RET3 & volume_ratio_20>=VR15 & 2-4 session volume shrink with low>=close[T]*(1-PULL2) & second breakout
event_rules.E10: volume_ratio_20>=VR25 & flat consolidation over T+1..T+5 (mean vr<=VRCAP, drawdown<=DDM, low>=close[T]*(1-PULL3))

regime_rule: BULL: Index>MA20>MA60 ; BEAR: Index<MA20<MA60 ; else NEUTRAL
